value.title: Write a blueprint
value.summary: Write a blueprint: the components that realise a PRD's rows, the decisions behind them, and what each loop or launch costs.

value.who: The PM that owns the work, or the prime when the operator asks.
value.when: When a project needs a new blueprint. Run it with `--key <slug>` so each document keeps its own progress.

value.name: slug
value.description: the kebab-case slug the PRD, blueprint and workstream share

value.title: Claim the blueprint number
value.done_when: `pij claim blueprint` holds a number for the slug, or `docs/project/blueprints/NNN-<slug>.dd.json` already exists.

value.title: Write the blueprint
value.done_when: The blueprint's sections are filled as `writing.md` says, every placeholder replaced.

value.title: Validate and render it
value.done_when: `ddocs validate` reports 0 errors and 0 warnings and the `.dd.md` is rebuilt and staged.

value.title: Write or update the workstream
value.done_when: A workstream step builds every component (PROC-docs-0003 is done for this slug).

sections.name: done_when
sections.value: `docs/project/blueprints/NNN-<slug>.dd.json` validates clean, its rendering is current, and both are staged.

value.text: Run ddocs from the repo root; the recipes do. From a subdirectory ddocs can't find the pij/* schemas (E401).
Guessing the number from the folder listing instead of claiming it.

value.guarantees: The blueprint how-to is this procedure; the old page points here.
